title: Short, simple, relatable stories that inspire confidence.
subtitle: From an everyday citizen who reshaped her ward, to officers who set the bar for ethical service.

items.label: Citizen Story
items.title: The citizen who made a difference
items.description: How one ward-sabha attendee turned a forgotten road project into a model of participatory planning — and a 90-day delivery.

items.label: Innovation
items.title: An idea that quietly changed lives
items.description: How a simple WhatsApp-based escalation protocol cut grievance resolution time at a district office from 21 days to 96 hours.

items.label: Public Servant
items.title: S. R. Sankaran — a life of justice
items.description: An exemplary IAS officer who set the standard for integrity, compassion and dedication to the most marginalised. Featured in The Better India.

items.label: Community in Action
items.title: Fisherfolk as first responders
items.description: How Kerala's traditional fishing community drove its boats inland in 2018 and rescued thousands — quietly redefining who counts as an emergency professional.

items.label: Public Health
items.title: Reverse Quarantine — shielding instead of isolating
items.description: A small idea with a large outcome: instead of isolating the infected, the system proactively shielded the elderly and the comorbid. It saved lives.
